profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker CCC. Its website, calgoncarbon.com, presents Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon leader in air and water purification. The site says modern communities face daunting air and water purification challenges and describes how Calgon Carbon uses activated carbon to meet those needs.

The website highlights FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon. It states that FILTRASORB has been proven by over 40 years of success in applications such as TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in the process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial arenas. It also says FILTRASORB is made in the United States. The company's SEC Central Index Key is 0001818201, and it is associated with 374 law exposure entries in Illinois.
